_comment: All account-id aliases for the DOR, in one file.
Two kinds of entry live here. They are told apart by the VALUE, so no
sections and no nesting are needed:
1. STRING value  ->  All User (Main) id : User MTM id
The All User sheet lists CC04 as a running INT account on VS7, but
the User MTM writes that same account as XLDH142 — and XLDH142 also
exists in All User as a dropped DLR ACC row. Without this map the
account cannot be classified and lands in Unclassified.
The alias column CANNOT be parsed for this: CC03, CC10 and CC11 carry
no trace of their MTM id (A19_CC03, CC_A8_CC10_4C, A27_MTPRO).
2. OBJECT value  ->  orderbook base id : { SERVER : User MTM id }
The orderbook records the base id, the User MTM the full id with its
A<nn> suffix — and the same base id is a DIFFERENT account on each
server, so the server is part of the key. TB2433 on VS8 is algo 1,
on VS29 it is algo 7.
add_user_aliases() can infer these by prefix when exactly one MTM
account on that server extends the orderbook id. This file is the
EXPLICIT form, applied first: inference is a guess that silently
stops working the day a second account shares the prefix. Anything
listed here is never guessed. An entry whose server or account is
absent from the User MTM is reported and skipped, never applied.
Ids are matched case-insensitively and leading zeros are ignored, so the
purely numeric string entries are already handled by that rule and are
listed only to document the known cases — they are harmless no-ops.
Add an account by adding one line. No code change, no redeploy.
This file is optional: if it is missing, both maps are simply empty and
account matching falls back to prefix inference.
